scope: The Lease's human mirror: the label name, the comment marker, and the exact comment body a member writes when it takes and gives back a Lease (ADR-0033 §6). Pinned across members because the mirror is the one part of the Lease a human reads, and because two members that spelled the label differently would leave one of them permanently attached to an issue nobody holds. Nothing here is authoritative: no selection, claim, expiry or fence decision may read a label or a comment.
